name: Mike LLM router compatibility stamp
description: Compatibility-only stamp on each Mike handoff payload. It records workspace router ownership and does not intercept Mike LLM calls. Grounded drafting goes through the complaint-generator MCP connector tools. Integrated into build_mike_handoff() and called automatically on every handoff construction.

handoff_payload.description: The Mike handoff payload dict to be patched in-place.
The same payload dict after mutation, with router_policy and non_negotiable_constraints set.
